en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing people standing inside stone ruins decorated for a celebration. The walls are rough masonry, likely the remains of an old church or castle. A large white panel with garlands and Swedish text is mounted on the central wall. More handwritten Swedish text appears below the image and along the left edge ("Adolf Gumerus Bokhandel"). The printed caption below the photograph mentions a fiftieth‑anniversary celebration at Gla Wasa in 1902.
